chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
For men: “Trim your nails,” and for women: “Leave some of your nails, for it is more beautifying for you.”

key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say about trimming nails for men and women?
ai.summary: This hadith relates guidance from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله concerning personal grooming for men and women. It distinguishes between trimming the nails for men and leaving some length for women as a form of beautification.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.315 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
For men: ‘trim your nails’, and for women: ‘let your nails grow a bit, for it is (source of) beauty for you.’
